scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The mixed ledger
scenes.caption: Nikhil gives Reva imaginary parcel measurements for sorting. The ledger looks tidy, but lengths use centimetres, millimetres and an unspecified unit. Before training, they need a data card explaining where measurements came from and their meaning.
scenes.speech: Nikhil gives Reva imaginary parcel measurements for sorting. The ledger looks tidy, but lengths use centimetres, millimetres and an unspecified unit. Before training, they need a data card explaining where measurements came from and their meaning.
scenes.dialogue: A table needs a data card.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Follow each source
scenes.caption: Their teacher created A and B and permitted classroom training. C comes from an unnamed upload without a permission note. Reva holds C: appearing onscreen does not establish permission to reuse a record.
scenes.speech: Their teacher created A and B and permitted classroom training. C comes from an unnamed upload without a permission note. Reva holds C: appearing onscreen does not establish permission to reuse a record.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Convert without guessing
scenes.caption: A measures 4 centimetres; B measures 60 millimetres, equivalent to 6 centimetres. D has a blank length, meaning unknown rather than zero. Nikhil keeps original values beside corrections so learners can trace what changed.
scenes.speech: A measures 4 centimetres; B measures 60 millimetres, equivalent to 6 centimetres. D has a blank length, meaning unknown rather than zero. Nikhil keeps original values beside corrections so learners can trace what changed.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: The tempting test row
scenes.caption: E has a complete measurement and checked label, but its card reserves it for testing. Choose whether to move E into training to enlarge it. Reva needs an honest unseen check, rather than an answer sheet rehearsed beforehand.
scenes.speech: E has a complete measurement and checked label, but its card reserves it for testing. Choose whether to move E into training to enlarge it. Reva needs an honest unseen check, rather than an answer sheet rehearsed beforehand.
scenes.dialogue: A reserved test keeps its role.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Choose consistent features
scenes.caption: The revised specification uses length in centimetres as input and a teacher checked parcel category as target. Row identifiers are bookkeeping, not measurements. Addresses and names are excluded because fictional parcel measurements need no information about senders.
scenes.speech: The revised specification uses length in centimetres as input and a teacher checked parcel category as target. Row identifiers are bookkeeping, not measurements. Addresses and names are excluded because fictional parcel measurements need no information about senders.
scenes.dialogue: Features must mean the same thing.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Before training starts
scenes.caption: Only permitted, complete training rows enter the model. Unknown units and missing measurements wait for clarification, while E remains separate. In the lab, repair the ledger, choose consistent features and document roles before declaring readiness.
